title: Tor-independent diagonal cotangent comparison with specified factor maps
statement: Let $A\to B$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings with $\operatorname{Tor}^A_i(B,B)=0$ for all $i>0$ [def-weil-pbc-tor-modules]. Put $D=B\otimes_A B$, $\iota_1(b)=b\otimes1$ and $\iota_2(b)=1\otimes b$. Use the ordinary-module derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] and derived extension of scalars (the universal total left derived functor of termwise tensor extension [def-weil-module-base-change]). The canonical comparison $\gamma:B\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}B\to D[0]$ is an isomorphism in $D(B)$, where the target $B$-action is through the second factor. For the standard cotangent complexes [lem-trf-cotangent-resolution-coherence], the canonical square-induced base-change morphism $\beta:L_{B/A}\otimes_{B,\iota_1}^{\mathbf L}D\longrightarrow L_{D/B}$ is an isomorphism in $D(D)$, where $L_{D/B}$ refers to $\iota_2$. Here $\beta$ is the extension-of-scalars adjoint of the standard functoriality map for the square $(A\to B)\to(B\xrightarrow{\iota_2}D)$ with vertical maps $A\to B$ and $\iota_1$. No flatness of $A\to B$ is assumed.

source.place: Tag 08R1 (lemma-bootstrap), first sentence invoking Tag 08QQ (lemma-flat-base-change-cotangent-complex); the Tor-to-derived-comparison argument of returned Step 1.

proof.text: Choose the standard polynomial resolution $P_\bullet\to B$ of [lem-trf-cotangent-resolution-coherence], and put $C=s(P_\bullet)$ with augmentation $q:C\to B[0]$. It is zero in positive degrees and $q$ is a quasi-isomorphism. By [lem-trf-polynomial-simplicial-tensor-model], its terms are free $A$-modules on monomials and are flat. Apply [lem-trf-flat-resolution-canonical-tensor-comparison] to $A\to B$, $N=B$ and $q$. For the universal derived scalar-extension pair in the statement it gives an isomorphism $j_q:Q_B(C\otimes_A B)\xrightarrow{\sim}B\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}B$ with $\gamma j_q=Q_B(q\otimes1)$. All tensors and the target localization here have the $B$-action on the second tensor factor.

source.place: Tag 08QP (lemma-flat-base-change), free resolution s(P) and its tensor augmentation; Tag 08QI (remark-resolution).

proof.text: Reindex $C$ homologically by $F_i=C^{-i}$. It is a free resolution of $B$, so [def-weil-pbc-tor-modules] identifies $H^{-i}(C\otimes_A B)$ with $\operatorname{Tor}^A_i(B,B)$ for $i>0$. These vanish by hypothesis; positive cohomology vanishes because the complex is nonpositive. The exact sequence $C^{-1}\to C^0\xrightarrow{q^0}B\to0$ remains right exact after tensoring by [lem-weil-pbc-tensor-right-exact]. Thus $H^0(q\otimes1)$ is precisely the isomorphism $\operatorname{coker}(d_C^{-1}\otimes1)\to D$, $[x\otimes b]\mapsto q^0(x)\otimes b$. Consequently $q\otimes1:C\otimes_A B\to D[0]$ is a quasi-isomorphism. Localization in [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] makes $Q_B(q\otimes1)$ invertible. Step 1 now gives $\gamma=Q_B(q\otimes1)j_q^{-1}$ invertible in $D(B)$, with the prescribed second-factor action.

source.place: Tag 00LY (section-tor), definition by a free resolution; Tag 00DF (lemma-tensor-product-exact); Tag 08R1 (lemma-bootstrap), hypothesis needed for its first sentence.

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-cotangent-flat-base-change] with its $C=B$, $A'=B$, $C'=D$, its upper horizontal map $A\to B$, lower horizontal map $\iota_2:B\to D$, and vertical maps $A\to B$ and $\iota_1:B\to D$. The square commutes since $f(a)\otimes1=1\otimes f(a)$. Its canonical derived multiplication has ordinary tensor map $b\otimes b'\mapsto\iota_1(b)\iota_2(b')=b\otimes b'$, so it is exactly $\gamma$ from Step 2. The cited theorem therefore makes its base-change morphism invertible. Its source extends scalars along $\iota_1$ and its target is $L_{D/B}$ for $\iota_2$. Moreover its morphism is, by its statement, the derived extension-of-scalars adjunct of the square-induced standard functoriality morphism. Hence it is the specified $\beta$, proving the remaining assertion without a flatness assumption.
